name: 林濬璈
objective:
介紹計算機演算法的設計與分析，內容包含了：函數成長，遞迴關係，排序及序列統計，基礎與進階資料結構，動態規劃，貪婪演算法，搜尋，圖形與幾何演算法，字串比對，NP-completeness, 近似演算法，及平行與分散式演算法.
This course gives a broad introduction about the design and analysis of computer algorithms. General topics to be covered include: growth of functions, recurrences, sorting and order statistics, fundamental and advanced data structures, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, searching, graph and geometry algorithms, string matching, NP-completeness, approximation algorithms, parallel and distributed algorithms.
schedule:
Week 01: Introduction
Week 02: Array
Week 03: Linked list
Week 04: Hash table
Week 05: Memorization, dynamic programming
Week 06: Disjoint classes
Week 07: Backtracking
Week 08: Tree (1/2)
Week 09: Tree (2/2) and immutable data structure
Week 10: Mid-term
Week 11: Priority queues
Week 12: Data compression
Week 13: Sorting (1/2)
Week 14: Sorting (2/2)
Week 15: Graph (1/2)
Week 16: Graph (2/2)
Week 17: Final 
Week 18: Final comments
materials:
Useful references:

1. Algorithm, 4th ed, https://algs4.cs.princeton.edu/home/, Robert Sedgewick and Kevin Wayne.
2. Introduction to Programming in Java, https://introcs.cs.princeton.edu/java/home/, Robert Sedgewick and Kevin Wayne.
3. Introduction to Algorithms, 3rd Edition by Thomas H Cormen, Charles E Leiserson, Ronald L Rivest, Clifford Stein
4. The Art of Computer Programming, vol. 2 & 3, https://www-cs-faculty.stanford.edu/~knuth/taocp.html, Donald E. Knuth.
